total_supply_zero.meaning: gauge _totalSupply equals zero after users withdraw all staked tokens

empty_period_elapsed.meaning: time passes with no deposits while total supply is zero

notify_reward_called.meaning: distribution contract calls notifyRewardAmount during the empty period to add rewards

full_epoch_stuck.meaning: the full epoch's emissions become permanently unclaimable and stuck in the contract after the gauge remains empty for an entire reward duration

assumptions: Reward tokens sent to the gauge are intended to be claimable by stakers rather than permanently retained by the contract.
The empty period spans an entire reward duration (one week).

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether notifyRewardAmount was actually called during the empty period; it is described as may be called, so the condition uses a symbolic occurrence flag.
No concrete numeric values are given for the skipped emissions or the reward duration amount.

limitations: The full one-week empty-epoch scenario is described as potential; whether it was observed is unspecified.
The condition is narrowed to the report's empty-period scenario with notifyRewardAmount called; the general requirement is not broadened beyond supplied statements.
